items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: Joe Harris, when Joe Harris was playing with us, you know, she gets Joe Harris.

ctx.x: I mean, Can't be the first drum.

Yeah, I told him, I said, No man. I said, I'm not doing for that. He said, I said, I'll take a piece of drum, I said, My husband's going to be gone. I said, I didn't know what three, four numbers happened. I know him, but I couldn't play him, you know, but I wouldn't have an hour with him. I said, You go there and see that lady and tell her that she's good. Joe Harris, when Joe Harris was playing with us, you know, she gets Joe Harris. I said, I'll do it on something. I know Joe could help me, you know.

items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Then we had Henry Russ. Ray McCormick.

ctx.x: Forty Hours playing Gittor. That was Forty Hours band.

Yeah. That's the little band. I never did mention all the little short bands. That was one of them. Then we had Henry Russ. Ray McCormick. He was playing that bass or drums? He was playing drums. See, Russ didn't even got all the drums, he was playing trumpet. Trumpet player, drum player, now he's playing bass.
Who was with Kid Renee when you played with him?
